stories.title: Tennisprofi Alexander Zverev krönt sich zum US-Open-Sieger

en.title: Tennis professional Alexander Zverev crowned US Open champion
en.summary: Alexander Zverev won the US Open, becoming the second German after Boris Becker to achieve this feat. The French Open champion defeated American Ben Shelton in the New York final to secure his second Grand Slam title.

stories.title: Fußball-Bundesliga: Behäbige Bayern mühen sich zum Sieg

en.title: Football Bundesliga: Sluggish Bayern secure narrow victory
en.summary: FC Bayern Munich won a narrow match against SV Elversberg, fielding seven new players in their starting lineup and displaying a cautious performance.

stories.title: Newsblog zum Nahost-Krieg: Treffen zwischen Iran und Oman zur Straße von Hormus wurde verschoben

en.title: Middle East war news blog: Meeting between Iran and Oman on Strait of Hormuz postponed
en.summary: A planned meeting between the foreign ministers of Iran and Oman to announce a resolution regarding the strategically important Strait of Hormuz for oil trade was postponed. Tehran stated the meeting was cancelled at the request of certain countries.

en.summary: German tennis star Alexander Zverev secured the US Open title by defeating Ben Shelton in four sets with a nearly flawless performance.

en.summary: The United States women's basketball team secured their 12th world championship title by defeating France in the final, overcoming an initial deficit.

en.summary: Tensions persist among Gulf states as Saudi Arabia closes a major east-west pipeline following attacks, and Iraq shuts a border crossing to Iran after a drone attack on Saudi infrastructure.

en.title: Lower Saxony municipal election: Green mayor Belit Onay leading in Hanover
en.summary: Incumbent Hanover mayor Belit Onay of the Green Party leads with approximately 45 percent of votes in intermediate results, clearly ahead of his SPD deputy.

en.title: Basketball World Cup: German women's team loses bronze medal match against Spain
en.summary: Germany's women's basketball team lost their third-place playoff against Spain, though the home tournament was among the most successful in the history of German women's basketball.

stories.title: Parlamentswahl: Sozialdemokraten bei Wahl in Schweden vorn – Ausgang offen

en.title: Parliamentary election: Social Democrats ahead in Sweden – outcome open
en.summary: Sweden's Social Democrats lead in the parliamentary election, threatening Prime Minister Kristersson's grip on power. However, it remains unclear which party or coalition will form the next government.

stories.title: Kommunalwahl: Niedersachsen hat gewählt – CDU vor SPD, AfD verdreifacht Ergebnis

en.title: Municipal election: Lower Saxony votes – CDU ahead of SPD, AfD triples result
en.summary: Six million voters in Lower Saxony participated in municipal elections amid the Volkswagen crisis. Initial results show the CDU leading, with the AfD achieving significantly increased support.

stories.title: Kanzler in der Krise: Wie Friedrich Merz seinen Machtverfall stoppen will

en.title: Chancellor in crisis: How Friedrich Merz wants to stop his decline in power
en.summary: Chancellor Merz travels to Finland while facing a domestic political crisis. There is speculation about whether his tenure could end after only 16 months as he attempts to secure his position.

en.title: Commentary: Trump and Bessent's financial acrobatics are adventurous
en.summary: The President and Treasury Secretary risk undermining American fiscal credibility through their financial policies. Their approach could potentially trigger bond market turmoil exceeding the severity of the 2008 financial crisis.

stories.title: Ukraine-Krieg: Russischer Angriff nahe ukrainischem Grenzübergang nach Polen – westliche Politiker betroffen

en.title: Ukraine War: Russian Attack Near Ukrainian Border Crossing to Poland – Western Politicians Affected
en.summary: A Russian attack occurred near a Ukrainian border crossing to Poland, with Western diplomats including a chancellor's adviser present at the site. No injuries were reported, though Polish officials expressed concern about the escalation.
